SANCTIONS ORDERED IN THE AMOUNT OF $65.00 AGAINST ATTORNEY PAUL ALAGA FOR FAILURE TO APPEAR IN PERSON AT THE HEARING ON THE MOTION TO CONTINUE TRIAL ON AUG-13-2024 IN DEPT. 206, PAYABLE ON OR BEFORE AUG-27-2024. NOTICE SENT BY COURT. (206)

MASTER CALENDAR MOTION ON AUG-13-2024 IN DEPT. 206, PLAINTIFF OMAR PEREZ, DEFENDANT A. RUIZ CONSTRUCTION CO. & ASSOC., INC., AND DEFENDANT CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO'S JOINT MOTION TO CONTINUE TRIAL AND ALL RELATED DEADLINES. NICOLE COSTEN, ESQ. APPEARING FOR DEFENDANT A. RUIZ CONSTRUCTION CO. & ASSOC., INC. REBECCA ALVARADO, ESQ. APPEARING FOR DEFENDANT CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO. NO APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF'S COUNSEL, PAUL ALAGA, AT THE CALLING OF THE CALENDAR. JUDGE MASSULLO PASSED THE MATTER FOR COURT STAFF TO CALL MR. ALAGA TO REQUIRE HIS APPEARANCE AT THE HEARING. MR. ALAGA WAS CONTACTED AND THE COURT ALLOWED HIM TO APPEAR VIA TELEPHONE UPON RECALLING THE MATTER. THE COURT IMPOSED A $65.00 SANCTION AGAINST MR. ALAGA FOR FAILURE TO APPEAR AT THE HEARING IN PERSON. THE COURT WILL NOT SET AN OSC, BUT SANCTIONS ARE TO BE PAID IN TWO WEEKS, BY 08/27/24. THE COURT CONTINUED THE MOTION TO 08/20/24 FOR PARTIES TO CONTACT THEIR EXPERTS TO CHECK ON THEIR AVAILABILITY FOR A CONTINUED TRIAL DATE OF 04/07/25. IF ALL AVAILABLE, THEN COUNSEL TO FILE A STIPULATION WITH A PROPOSED ORDER AND EMAIL DEPT. 206 AT DEPARTMENT206@SFTC.ORG. NO APPEARANCES WILL BE REQUIRED AND THE COURT WILL VACATE THE 08/20/24 HEARING DATE. IF THE 04/07/25 DATE DOES NOT WORK OUT, THEN COUNSEL TO MEET & CONFER AND SELECT ANOTHER DATE IN APRIL 2025. IF PARTIES CANNOT AGREE, THEN COUNSEL ARE REQUIRED TO APPEAR IN PERSON ON AUG-20-2024 AT 9:30AM IN DEPT. 206 FOR THE COURT TO ASSIST PARTIES. JUDGE: ANNE-CHRISTINE MASSULLO; MATTER NOT REPORTED (206)
